prompt.en: In what year did Quebec grant women the vote?
prompt.fr: En quelle année le Québec a-t-il accordé le droit de vote aux femmes?

explanation.en: Thérèse Casgrain and others won the provincial vote for women in Quebec in 1940.
explanation.fr: Thérèse Casgrain et d'autres ont obtenu le vote provincial pour les femmes au Québec en 1940.

source.quote: Due to the work of Thérèse Casgrain and others, Quebec granted women the vote in 1940.

verification.evidence: Due to the work of Thérèse Casgrain and others, Quebec granted women the vote in 1940.
